symptom: a consumed REST service whose base URL is a constant shows an empty BaseUrl in the catalog (CATALOG.CONSUMED_REST_SERVICES), indistinguishable from one with no base URL
cause: the reader type-asserted Rest$ValueTemplate only; a Rest$ConstantValue base URL fell through and was dropped
insight: A gen property typed element.Element is a union: read every concrete type it can hold, not the one the writer emits. Kept apart from BaseUrl (BaseUrlConstant) so describe and its round trip, which only know literals, are unchanged
